component.name: Hanzi
component.summary: Train Mandarin characters and words in shuffled groups

description.p: Hanzi is a focused Mandarin vocabulary trainer for HSK 3.0 levels 1–5 (2025 syllabus). Open a group, train it in shuffled order, or pick a single character or word. Practice by choosing the translation or writing the characters from memory.

ul.li: 1,527 characters and 2,770 words from HSK 3.0 levels 1–5
Character and word groups per level, plus combined groups
Custom groups: append entries during review and train them like built-in groups
Mastery colors driven by correct quiz picks and clean writings
Two input modes: translation choices or writing from pinyin and meaning
Mode switch in the header, including mid-session
Native stroke-order hints and stroke tracing

screenshot.caption: Translation quiz with a mastered character
Add the current entry to a custom group

description.p: First release: HSK 3.0 (2025 syllabus) levels 1–5 character and word groups, shuffled training, translation quiz, writing review, custom groups, mastery colors, and stroke-order data.
